name: Homepage motion, visible play action and saved solo turn
description: The demo completes a match without blocking the primary action.
steps: Verify Play vs AI is visible before scrolling. Observe cards entering from opposite edges and moving between fronts. Pause the demo, verify it stops, then restart and play it.
Observe turns 1 through 12, checkpoint scoring and a 10–8 finish followed by an automatic fresh game.
Choose Casual, click the first Play vs AI, deploy King to Sea and lock. After turn 2, reload, then explicitly Continue saved solo game.
expected: Cards move inside the clipped board without fading. The loop restarts, and the saved solo turn survives reload.

name: Mobile actions, scoring and motion controls
description: The mobile home stays compact and all actions retain v0.2 behavior.
steps: Verify Play vs AI is visible before scrolling. Pause the demo and use Next demo turn repeatedly through twelve turns; restart. Verify no page overflow.
Start solo. Turn 1 deploy King to Sea. Turn 2 Shift King to Land. Turn 3 Recall King. Turn 4 deploy King to Air. Lock each order and wait for the reveal.
Verify turn 5: Ace, 2 and King are spent. Open Game details, Scoring details and Rules, then close each.
expected: The action stays accessible and movement, payment, scoring, recall and exhaustion are correct.

name: Private online table across two actors
description: Two separate browser contexts reveal only after both orders lock.
steps: Actor A clicks Invite a friend and copies the invitation. Actor B opens it in a separate context and clicks Join table.
A deploys King to Sea and locks. B must see an empty board and no opposing order details. B deploys Queen to Land and locks. Both advance to turn 2.
Reload both, explicitly Rejoin private table, then open Game details and Reconnect. Each deploys another legal card and locks.
expected: Both recover their correct seat, see the same resolved board, and advance live without leaking pending orders.

name: Local complete game with private handoffs
description: Local players retain simultaneous orders and can finish a match.
steps: Choose Local 2-player. Player 1 clicks I’m ready, deploys King to Sea and locks. Player 2 sees only a handoff, then an unchanged empty board after clicking I’m ready.
Player 2 deploys Queen to Land and locks. Click Reveal together, then Next turn. Reload and explicitly Continue local game.
Complete the remaining eleven turns by selecting legal deployments at each handoff, revealing together and choosing Next turn. At the final result choose Play again.
expected: Selections remain concealed until shared reveal, completed turns persist, and play again starts a new twelve-turn game.

name: Invalid input and room failure keep solo available
description: Invalid or failed online actions do not block solo play.
steps: Open Already have an invitation, paste invalid-link and join. Confirm validation. Invite a friend and confirm the injected visible error.
Start solo. Lock order, Shift and Recall should be disabled on an empty board. Select King only and verify an incomplete order still cannot lock.
Deploy King to Sea and lock. Return to Lobby, start solo again and choose Keep saved game. Continue saved solo game.
expected: The original turn is retained, validation is visible, and online failure does not prevent solo play.
